title: Personal AI Developer Assistant
instruction: Rewrite this project vision note into the vault house style. Preserve the intro line plus bullet-list structure and keep the wording concise.
input_markdown:
# Personal AI Developer Assistant
## Goal
Build a local AI assistant that can:
- write code
- learn from previous projects
- create new notes
- update existing notes
- refactor knowledge
- search personal knowledge base
- explain previous solutions
## Sources of knowledge
- Obsidian Vault
- ServerX
- Inception
- 42 School projects
- LeetCode solutions
- Future projects
## Long term vision
The assistant should gradually improve the knowledge base by:
- creating notes
- updating notes
- linking notes
- summarizing experience
- extracting patterns
